name: Keene Village Plastics (Village Plastics)
summary: Long-established US industrial plastics manufacturer that extruded its way into 3D printing filament at wholesale scale, self-describing as "the largest manufacturer of high-quality 3D printer filaments in the United States". Operates consumer-facing as Village Plastics and reached the hobbyist market by acquiring the MakeShaper filament brand in 2018/2019.

oem_relationships.notes: MakeShaper is a wholly-owned sub-brand since the 2018/2019 acquisition, not an arm's-length customer; KVP manufactures MakeShaper filament itself rather than sourcing it externally. Recorded here for traceability of the label; MakeShaper has no independent manufacturing presence and so gets no separate entry.

product_lines.name: PAPC
product_lines.notes: Nylon/polycarbonate line; exact composition not documented in sources, so both base ids are listed provisionally.

product_lines.name: 3D Solve
product_lines.notes: Soluble support line; solvent chemistry not stated in sources, so the pva mapping is provisional.

product_lines.name: Welding rod
product_lines.notes: Thermoplastic welding rod — an industrial product line, not 3D printing filament, reflecting the company's plastics heritage.

additional_notes: Corporate geography is unresolved: the consumer site gives East Longmeadow, Massachusetts, company imagery references a "Keene Village Plastics Factory" tied to Keene, New Hampshire-area operations, and ThomasNet separately lists a Euclid, Ohio facility — KVP appears to run multiple US sites and the HQ-vs-factory-of-record distinction was not settled. All identified sites are domestic, so manufacturing_countries is unambiguous even though the specific address is not. Also sells "Koil", a spool-less packaging format. Price tier is inferred from industrial/wholesale QC positioning rather than observed USD/kg.

provenance.conflicts: Sources disagree on the company's principal location: East Longmeadow MA (own site), Keene NH (factory imagery/name), and Euclid OH (ThomasNet). Treated as a multi-site US manufacturer with HQ unresolved. The PAPC and 3D Solve filament_ids mappings are provisional pending datasheets.
